passage.label: Al-Baqarah — Allah's parables, breaking covenants, cycle of life and death, creation of earth and heavens

arabicExcerpts.text: ۞إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَسۡتَحۡيِۦٓ أَن يَضۡرِبَ مَثَلٗا مَّا بَعُوضَةٗ فَمَا فَوۡقَهَاۚ فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ فَيَعۡلَمُونَ أَنَّهُ ٱلۡحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّهِمۡۖ وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فَيَقُولُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَٰذَا مَثَلٗاۘ يُضِلُّ بِهِۦ كَثِيرٗا وَيَهۡدِي بِهِۦ كَثِيرٗاۚ وَمَا يُضِلُّ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا ٱلۡفَٰسِقِينَ
ٱلَّذِينَ يَنقُضُونَ عَهۡدَ ٱللَّهِ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مِيثَٰقِهِۦ وَيَقۡطَعُونَ مَآ أَمَرَ ٱللَّهُ بِهِۦٓ أَن يُوصَلَ وَيُفۡسِدُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡخَٰسِرُونَ
كَيۡفَ تَكۡفُرُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَكُنتُمۡ أَمۡوَٰتٗا فَأَحۡيَٰكُمۡۖ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمۡ ثُمَّ يُحۡيِيكُمۡ ثُمَّ إِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ
هُوَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ لَكُم مَّا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ جَمِيعٗا ثُمَّ ٱسۡتَوَىٰٓ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَسَوَّىٰهُنَّ سَبۡعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٖۚ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمٞ

mainSubject.label: Allah presents parables without hesitation; divergent responses of believers and disbelievers; condemnation of covenant-breakers; cycle of life-death-resurrection; creation of earth and seven heavens

subordinateSubjects.label: Allah not ashamed to present any parable, even a mosquito or smaller
Believers recognize parables as truth from their Lord
Disbelievers question Allah's intent behind parables
Parables mislead many and guide many; only the fasiqeen are misled
Breaking Allah's covenant after its confirmation
Severing what Allah commanded to be joined
Those who break covenants are the losers (al-khasiroon)
Rhetorical question: how can you disbelieve in Allah?
Cycle: lifeless → brought to life → die → revived → returned to Him
Creation of everything on earth for humanity
Directing Himself to the heaven and making seven heavens
Allah as Aleem (Knowing of all things)

humanConditionsAndSpiritualStates.label: Certainty of believers regarding divine truth in parables
Defiant disobedience (fusuq) as condition for being misled by parables
Original state of lifelessness before divine animation

socialEconomicCivilisational.label: Covenant-breaking and severing ties as social/spiritual corruption

relationships.label: Return to Allah as final destination

notes: Pass A pilot 3, passage 5/4. Contains first mention of amthal (parables), covenant vocabulary (ahd/meethaq), and seven heavens cosmology.
